messages.content: A small bakery sells bread, cakes and cookies. Each morning the baker prepares fresh dough, bakes several batches and arranges them on shelves before customers arrive. Summarize the daily routine of this bakery in two sentences.

response.text: Each morning, the baker prepares fresh dough, bakes several batches of bread, cakes, and cookies, and arranges them on the shelves. By the time customers arrive, the bakery is ready with a fresh selection of baked goods for the day.
